name: THE MOURNERS
note: THE MOURNERS (doc 05, doc 54), the town at the graveside with their hats held. One group: they stand close and overlap, so they are one cut (tools/art/room31-cast.py), and their actions are a few of them shifting their weight at once (errata 78: 'one man shifting his weight is enough to stop it being a photograph'). The master drew seven, and the lines count seven (Tyler, 2026-11-06, errata 99 P). Examined through THE MOURNERS and THE HATS over them (errata 99 G).
barksNote: The mourners are heard through their LISTEN lines.
